limitations: Three fresh Node processes per representation, alternating order on one local machine.
Decode timing excludes filesystem reads, hashing, network transfer, gzip work and map rendering.
Peak RSS is for each whole Node process, not browser heap or a real mobile device.
Canonical GeoJSON is retained; the compact representation preserves every browser-validated candidate value.
Gzip byte sizes are locally computed estimates, not measured live-server transfer sizes.
